caption: A moth flutters through the beam of a projector in a dark hall and is brightly lit only while it is inside the cone of light.

sa.check: A moth flutters through the beam of a projector.
It is brightly lit only while inside the cone of light.

pc.expect: The moth is dim outside the beam, flares bright as it enters, and dims again as it leaves.
pc.fail: It is bright outside the beam; or dark inside it; or stays bright after leaving.

pc.expect: The brightness changes only with the moth's position in the beam.
pc.fail: It flickers with the moth still; or the beam moves; or the hall brightens.

pc.expect: Its shadow appears on the screen while it is in the beam.
pc.fail: There is no shadow in the beam; or a shadow outside it; or the shadow is away from the beam's line.

pc.expect: The beam is one cone from the projector.
pc.fail: It bends; or splits; or floods the hall.
It splits; or a wing detaches; or a second moth appears.

pc.expect: The hall and the screen stay the same.
pc.fail: The picture changes with no click; or the hall rearranges; or the projector changes.

note: The moth is self-driven; only the light on it is judged. Illumination: the on/off causality of electric lights belongs to Electricity; here only where the light goes once it exists is judged.
